summary: Adds a discount code field to Order, plus two new endpoints. One returns an order's details and the other redeems a welcome discount code.

findings.title: Order detail lacks owner check
findings.problem: The order_detail view looks up the order by primary key alone. It never filters by request.user.
findings.consequence: Any logged-in user can read any other user's order total and discount code by changing the order id.
findings.fix: Add owner=request.user to the lookup, the same way the redeem view does.

findings.title: Decimal multiplied by float
findings.problem: The apply_discount method multiplies a Decimal total by the float 0.9. Python raises TypeError for Decimal times float.
findings.consequence: Every valid WELCOME10 redemption crashes with a server error. No user can apply the discount.
findings.fix: Multiply by a Decimal and quantize the result to two decimal places.

findings.title: Missing migration for discount_code
findings.problem: The change adds the discount_code field to Order but adds no migration. The only migration is 0001_initial, and it has no discount_code column.
findings.consequence: Every Order query selects a column that does not exist. As a result, order_list and the new views fail with a database error.
findings.fix: Run makemigrations and commit the new migration for discount_code.

findings.title: CSRF protection disabled on redeem
findings.problem: The redeem view changes state for a session-authenticated user but turns off CSRF checks. The project uses session auth with CsrfViewMiddleware, so this view needs no exemption.
findings.consequence: Any third-party site can make a logged-in user's browser change that user's orders without consent.
findings.fix: Remove the csrf_exempt decorator and its import.

findings.title: New discount behaviour has no tests
findings.problem: No test covers apply_discount, order_detail or redeem. The repository has no test files at all.
findings.consequence: Tests would have caught the Decimal crash and the missing owner check before release.
findings.fix: Add tests for a valid code, an invalid code, a repeat redemption, and access to another user's order.
